note: House League items, batch 1 of 4 (DC-H1): six Charms on existing rule pieces, written and landed together by E18-C08. Amounts and prices are provisional (E24).

design.trigger: +30 Value when the head pin (rack position 1) falls in the frame, whatever its material and whichever roll knocked it down.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A crown-less pin silhouette at the apex of the rack diagram; the head pin flashes when it counts.

design.trigger: +3 Value for each Wood Pin knocked down in the frame (up to +30 with a full Wood rack).
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1. Old Lou's first-clear reward once E22-L01 declares gate.old_lou_cleared.
design.presentation_needs: A wood-grain plank badge; each Wood Pin down adds a grain line to the count.

design.trigger: ×2 Mult in the first frame of every match. The mirror of Last Chance, which doubles the second.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A curtain-up marquee; it lights for frame 1 and dims for frame 2.

design.trigger: +4 Mult on an open frame (pins still standing after both rolls).
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: An open door with a welcome mat; it swings open when the frame scores as open.

design.trigger: +$1 after every strike, paid with the frame's income. The strike counterpart of Tip Jar.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A coin slot jar with an X on the lid; one coin drops after each strike.

design.trigger: +8 Value for each pin still standing at the end of the frame.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: Stubborn pins with folded arms; each standing pin adds a figure.
